name: Slot Reels
description: The frame is cut into vertical reels that spin downward like drums, motion-blurred with speed, carrying the first clip then the second, and stop one after another from left to right with a small mechanical bounce. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: blur
params.description: Amount of vertical motion blur while the reels spin fast

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between the first and the last reel's stop, as a part of the transition

params.name: bounce
params.description: Size of the bounce when a reel stops

params.name: separator
params.description: Color of the separators between the reels
